[[File:Revenge_of_the_King.jpg|thumb]] 
'''Revenge of the King '''is the second Legends of Cybertron mission, Succeeding [[Rulers of Kaon]] and preceding [[Rise of Kolkular]].

==Intro==
Start:

* [[Optimus Prime|'''Optimus Prime''']]: ''Grimlock, the wastelands of New Quintessa grow with bots claiming to be legends. Pretenders to the title Legends of Cybertron.''
* '''[[Grimlock]]''': ''Me Grimlock is only legend that matters. Me King, me rule all!''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Forgive me old friend, but I recall you did not fare as well as I would have predicted when the legends gathered last.''
* '''Grimlock''': ''Arrrrgh! That was stupid Megatron's fault. This time different. Me Grimlock will crush all!''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''And how will this time be different? Megatron and others are out there and they are stronger than ever.''
* '''Grimlock''': ''Me Grimlock look past that past to real past. The ground will shake and enemies quake. This time King Grimlock is getting Jurassic!''

End:

* '''Grimlock''': ''Bah, you made it this far. Me Grimlock told Optimus me the only Legend that matters. Me Grimlock show you that me king!''

== Bots ==

=== [[Optimus Primal]] - Melee Damage 6 ===

=== [[Dinobot]] - Armor Pierce 6 ===

=== [[Ramjet]] - Special Damage 6 ===

=== [[Shockwave]] - Ranged Damage 6 ===

=== [[Prowl]] - Power Charge 6 ===

=== [[Megatron]] (G1) - Cycle Resist 6 ===

=== [[Kickback]] - Power Wipe 2 ===

=== [[Waspinator]] - Ranged Damage Timed 6 ===
Waspinator is the only Bot at half his Signature Ability Level instead of the others at maximum, to slightly ease up his revive health.

=== [[Rhinox]] - Stagger 6 ===

=== [[Windblade]] - Debuff Duration 6 ===

=== [[Blaster]] - Ranged Damage 6 ===

=== [[Grimlock]] - Life Transfer 2 ===

== Rewards ==

* Tier 4 Basic Spark
* Class Sparks of all six classes
* 550,000 Gold 
* [[Stable Nucleon Core]]
* 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards
* 4 3-Star Class Spark Crystals
* 10 5-Star Signature Upgrades

Revenge of the King mail.jpg
</gallery>
